---
title: "Enhanced model"
author: "KSA"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d')`"
output: md_document
params:
  # one subfolder per WWTP, each produced by run.bash
  batch_dir: "results/enhanced"
  # same as batch_dir, but with temperature and timestamps as model input
  batch_dir_wtemp: "results/enhanced_wtemp"
  # Mariagerfjord predicted with different prediction windows
  predwindow_dir: "results/predwindow_mariagerfjord"
  cluster_type: "graph"
  # prediction window (number of samples ahead) used for the examples
  predwindow: 10
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  error = FALSE,
  fig.width = 12,
  fig.height = 10,
  cache = FALSE
)

# when knitting the working directory is always the folder of the Rmd file
if (interactive() && !grepl("analysis$", getwd())) {
  setwd("analysis")
}

library("ampvis2")
library("data.table")
library("patchwork")
library("lubridate")
library("tune")

source("functions.R")
set.seed(42)
```

Figures for the paper. The results folders and the prediction window used for the examples are set in the YAML header. Each figure is saved as a PDF/PNG together with a CSV file of the data behind it, next to the results it's made from.

# Prediction accuracy across WWTPs

Bray-Curtis dissimilarity between real and predicted abundances for each graph cluster. One row per prediction window, one column per WWTP (number of samples in parentheses).

```{r accuracy, fig.width=14, fig.height=14}
accuracy <- boxplot_all(
  params$batch_dir,
  error_metrics = "Bray Curtis",
  cluster_types = "Graph",
  plot_width = 360,
  plot_height = 370
)
accuracy
```

## With temperature and timestamps as input

```{r accuracy_wtemp, fig.width=14, fig.height=14}
accuracy_wtemp <- boxplot_all(
  params$batch_dir_wtemp,
  error_metrics = "Bray Curtis",
  cluster_types = "Graph",
  plot_width = 360,
  plot_height = 370
)
accuracy_wtemp
```

# Example: a single ASV

Real and predicted relative abundance of *Ca.* Microthrix parvicella (ASV2) in Aalborg W over time (left), and real vs. predicted abundance (right). The vertical line marks the start of the test period.

```{r single_asv, fig.height=5}
aalborg_w_dir <- file.path(params$batch_dir, "Aalborg W")
aalborg_w <- amp_export_long(
  combine_abund(aalborg_w_dir, params$cluster_type, params$predwindow)
)
microthrix <- aalborg_w[grepl("^ASV2;", OTU)]

single_asv <- plot_ts_obs_pred(microthrix)
single_asv
ggsave(
  file.path(aalborg_w_dir, "ASV2.png"),
  plot = single_asv,
  width = 12,
  height = 5
)
```

# Figure 3: Time series examples

The same plot for three ASVs from Aalborg Vest-LT1.

```{r figure3}
figure3_dir <- "results/Aalborg Vest-LT1"
figure3_asvs <- c("FLASV3.1527", "FLASV9592.1533", "FLASV4.1481")

figure3_long <- amp_export_long(
  combine_abund(figure3_dir, params$cluster_type, params$predwindow)
)
figure3_data <- lapply(
  figure3_asvs,
  function(asv) figure3_long[startsWith(OTU, paste0(asv, ";"))]
)

figure3 <- stack_ts_obs_pred(figure3_data)
figure3
save_figure(
  figure3,
  data = rbindlist(figure3_data),
  path = file.path(figure3_dir, "Figure 3.pdf")
)
```

# Figure 5: PCoA

PCoA (Bray-Curtis) of real and predicted samples from Mariagerfjord. Each line connects a real sample with the prediction for the same date.

```{r figure5, fig.width=10}
figure5 <- plot_pcoa(
  file.path(params$batch_dir, "Mariagerfjord"),
  cluster_type = params$cluster_type,
  predwindow = params$predwindow
)
figure5
save_figure(
  figure5,
  data = figure5$data,
  path = file.path(params$batch_dir, "Figure 5.pdf")
)
```

# Figure 6: Prediction accuracy vs. prediction window

Bray-Curtis dissimilarity between real and predicted abundances for each graph cluster in Mariagerfjord, by how many samples ahead were predicted.

```{r figure6, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
predwindow_runs <- list.dirs(params$predwindow_dir, recursive = FALSE)

figure6_data <- rbindlist(
  lapply(predwindow_runs, read_performance, add_numsamples = FALSE)
)[cluster_type == "Graph" & error_metric == "Bray Curtis" & value > 0]

figure6 <- ggplot(figure6_data, aes(factor(predwindow), value)) +
  geom_boxplot(color = "#D58078", fill = "#D58078", alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    trans = "sqrt",
    breaks = c(0.0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7)
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(x = "Prediction window (samples ahead)", y = "Bray Curtis") +
  theme_bw()
figure6
save_figure(
  figure6,
  data = figure6_data,
  path = file.path(params$predwindow_dir, "Figure 6.pdf"),
  width = 180,
  height = 180
)
```

# Figure 7 and S8: Time series by prediction window

Real and predicted abundance of a single ASV in Mariagerfjord, one row per prediction window.

```{r predwindow_data}
predwindow_long <- lapply(
  predwindow_runs,
  function(run) amp_export_long(combine_abund(run, params$cluster_type))
)
```

## Figure 7: ASV1

```{r figure7, fig.height=14}
figure7_data <- predwindow_panels(predwindow_long, "^ASV1;")
figure7 <- stack_ts_obs_pred(figure7_data) +
  plot_annotation(title = otu_label(figure7_data[[1]]$OTU[[1]]))
figure7
save_figure(
  figure7,
  data = rbindlist(figure7_data, idcol = "panel"),
  path = file.path(params$predwindow_dir, "Figure 7.pdf"),
  width = 300,
  height = 350
)
```

## Figure S8: ASV24

```{r figureS8, fig.height=14}

figureS8
```
